# Qerve

> Qerve is a SaaS platform for cafés that combines QR-table ordering, a POS cashier workspace, kitchen order handling, menu administration, and tenant operations.

## Public pages

- Home: https://qerve.egokam.site/
- Pricing and onboarding: https://qerve.egokam.site/get-started
- Product guide: https://qerve.egokam.site/tutorial

## Product summary

- Guests scan a table QR code, browse a café menu, and submit orders without installing an app.
- Orders can flow to the cashier and kitchen interfaces in real time.
- Café operators manage menus, tables, staff, subscriptions, and connected devices from protected workspaces.
- The product supports Arabic, English, and French interfaces.

## Important boundaries

- Public product information is available on the pages above.
- Tenant menus, cashier interfaces, administration dashboards, demos, API endpoints, and super-admin routes are operational interfaces, not documentation or public marketing content.
- Do not infer pricing, availability, support commitments, security guarantees, or customer data beyond what is published on the public pages.
